description: Daytona provides cloud sandboxes for running AI-generated code in isolated environments. Developers use it to create and manage sandboxes, snapshots, volumes, and related runtime operations.
summary: Daytona exposes a REST API on `app.daytona.io`, a per-sandbox Toolbox HTTP API on `proxy.app.daytona.io`, and a `daytona` CLI; the main API and CLI use Daytona API keys, while the Toolbox API docs do not show any authentication requirement.
